description: Recorded regression floor for the Tier-2 TF-IDF routing harness (scripts/run-routing-evals.js --ratchet). Not a target — a floor. rank1_rate and mrr must not fall below these values, and must_not_violations must not rise above its ceiling. Raise these when the router improves; lowering one is a deliberate act that shows up in the diff.

targets.note: Aspirational. Reported as a gap by --ratchet; gated only in the harness default mode.
